title: Bible reader
summary: Useful content hierarchy. Preserve reader control over the body font, size, and spacing.

annotations.label: Reference
annotations.suggestion: Keep a compact navigation role; preserve the chapter number when space is tight.

annotations.label: Version chip
annotations.suggestion: Keep the strong short identifier; align its weight with the shared control role.

annotations.label: Section heading
annotations.suggestion: Keep the reader-size bold heading; this is content, not a screen title.

annotations.label: Verse body
annotations.suggestion: Keep the user-selected reading size. Default is 18dp, independent of system font scale.

annotations.label: Verse numbers
annotations.suggestion: Keep the 0.7× content relationship; check contrast separately.

title: Version manager
summary: The 18sp bold / 13sp regular pair is an isolated list hierarchy, also copied by the version sheet.

annotations.label: Screen title
annotations.suggestion: Use the same screen-title role in XML and Compose.

annotations.label: All-caps tabs
annotations.suggestion: Match casing, size, tracking, and weight with Compose tabs.

annotations.label: Language group
annotations.suggestion: Use a shared secondary/section-label role; avoid relying on low opacity for hierarchy.

annotations.label: Version name
annotations.suggestion: Consider a shared 16sp medium list-primary role; retain a clear selected state.

annotations.label: Version description
annotations.suggestion: Promote to shared 14sp regular supporting text; retire this one-off 13sp size.

title: Version selection sheet
summary: This sheet intentionally mirrors the version manager, so change both together.

annotations.label: Version name
annotations.suggestion: Share a list-primary token with the version manager.

annotations.label: Version description
annotations.suggestion: Use 14sp regular supporting text in both version surfaces.

annotations.label: Footer action
annotations.suggestion: Keep the common 14sp medium action role.

title: Navigation drawer
summary: The drawer already has a restrained, repeatable hierarchy.

annotations.label: Navigation item
annotations.suggestion: Keep 16sp regular; use this same list-primary role in other menus.

annotations.label: Section label
annotations.suggestion: Keep secondary sizing; name the role explicitly.

annotations.label: Switch label
annotations.suggestion: Keep the same primary size as the navigation items.

title: Reading appearance panel
summary: Internally consistent, but uses 12sp bold labels alongside 16sp values.

annotations.label: Section label
annotations.suggestion: Prefer a shared 14sp medium section label for readability; update all labels together.

annotations.label: Font selector
annotations.suggestion: Keep the font preview and 16sp value; the preview may deliberately use the selected face.

annotations.label: Slider value
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared value role and use tabular digits when available.

annotations.label: Contrast label
annotations.suggestion: Use the same section-label role as the other controls, including the ratio.

title: Go To dialer
summary: The keypad size has a purpose. Its weight differs from the song keypad.

annotations.label: Tabs
annotations.suggestion: Use the shared tab role; make the container accommodate large text.

annotations.label: Book selector
annotations.suggestion: Keep the shared 16sp field value role.

annotations.label: Chapter / verse value
annotations.suggestion: Keep an explicit prominent-number exception, shared with comparable numeric controls.

annotations.label: Keypad digit
annotations.suggestion: Use the same 28sp regular keypad token in song selection.

title: Go To book grid
summary: At 100% the grid works, but it inherits bodyLarge and fixes six columns.

annotations.label: Book abbreviation
annotations.suggestion: Make this an explicit navigation-grid role; adapt the number of columns to text size.

annotations.label: Tabs
annotations.suggestion: Allow scrolling or enough width and height for full labels. See the 200% comparison.

title: Settings categories
summary: Simple categories already use the same 16sp primary size as the drawer.

annotations.label: Screen title
annotations.suggestion: Map XML and Compose titles onto one screen-title role.

annotations.label: Category row
annotations.suggestion: Keep this shared list-primary role; use it in bookmark categories too.

title: Development feedback sheet
summary: A Compose title uses 22sp regular, compared with the smaller audio sheet headings.

annotations.label: Sheet title
annotations.suggestion: Use a shared sheet-title role across feedback, audio, and media.

annotations.label: Explanation
annotations.suggestion: Keep 16sp body text and its generous line height.

annotations.label: Primary action
annotations.suggestion: Keep the shared action-label role; avoid extra bold variants.

title: Display preferences
summary: A useful 16sp / 14sp hierarchy that can anchor other lists.

annotations.label: Preference title
annotations.suggestion: Keep this list-primary style.

annotations.label: Preference summary
annotations.suggestion: Keep this supporting-text style; reuse it instead of 13sp descriptions.

title: Sync sign-in
summary: Compose controls are coherent, but informational links are unstyled embedded TextViews.

annotations.label: Screen title
annotations.suggestion: Align with the XML screen-title role rather than inheriting a second title system.

annotations.label: Informational link
annotations.suggestion: Set size, family, weight, and line height explicitly when bridging to AndroidView.

annotations.label: Field label / value
annotations.suggestion: Keep the shared field role and validate floating labels at large font sizes.

annotations.label: Button label
annotations.suggestion: Keep the shared action role; use consistent sentence casing.

title: Bible search input
summary: The search input comes from a different default system than song search.

annotations.label: Search title
annotations.suggestion: Use the shared screen-title role.

annotations.label: Search input
annotations.suggestion: Consider the shared 16sp field role used by song search, unless 18sp is a deliberate search-wide decision.

annotations.label: Filter labels
annotations.suggestion: Match the chip/filter role used by song search while preserving checkbox accessibility.

annotations.label: Search tips
annotations.suggestion: Keep instructional emphasis sparingly; use shared help text rather than allowing reader size to dictate control help.

title: Bible search results
summary: Reference titles use 1.2× the reading size, larger than ordinary screen titles at default settings.

annotations.label: Result reference
annotations.suggestion: Use a deliberate result-title role; avoid 1.2× reader scaling if the title is navigation. Keep the underlined affordance if needed.

annotations.label: Verse excerpt
annotations.suggestion: Preserve the chosen reading face/size for excerpts; cap the preview by lines rather than shrinking text.

annotations.label: Matched word
annotations.suggestion: Keep bold match emphasis; ensure the match color remains readable with the reading theme.

title: Help / About
summary: The brand heading is a reasonable exception. Action rows use 18sp instead of the usual 16sp.

annotations.label: Brand heading
annotations.suggestion: Keep one brand-display exception; do not use this size for ordinary screen titles.

annotations.label: Build metadata
annotations.suggestion: Keep shared supporting text; use a stable line-height token.

annotations.label: Description
annotations.suggestion: Keep 16sp body text.

annotations.label: Action row
annotations.suggestion: Consider the shared 16sp primary-list role to match Settings.

title: Devotion article
summary: Article typography follows reading preferences. HTML spans may introduce publisher-specific headings.

annotations.label: Toolbar title
annotations.suggestion: Use the common screen-title role for chrome.

annotations.label: Toolbar date
annotations.suggestion: Use a named toolbar-subtitle role; a 14sp supporting role would reduce competition.

annotations.label: Article heading
annotations.suggestion: Preserve semantic article headings; cap or wrap them rather than applying UI-title tokens. Size is 1.25× the 18dp reading base for this article.

annotations.label: Article body
annotations.suggestion: Keep the user-selected reading font and the article pinch-zoom behavior.

title: Devotion selection sheet
summary: This compact selector does not need an additional decorative heading.

annotations.label: Devotion selector
annotations.suggestion: Keep the shared field-value role.

annotations.label: Date action
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared action-label role and allow long localized date strings to fit.

title: Songbook download catalog
summary: This server-rendered WebView uses its own CSS typography. CSS pixels are not sp.

annotations.label: Native screen title
annotations.suggestion: Use the shared screen-title role.

annotations.label: Web tabs
annotations.suggestion: Align web tab weight/case with native tabs; share documented design values across repositories.

annotations.label: Songbook identifier
annotations.suggestion: Keep a 16px primary role, with an explicit sans-serif fallback in the page.

annotations.label: Book title / copyright
annotations.suggestion: Keep 14px supporting text; reduce dependence on low opacity for credits.

title: Song content
summary: The song has semantic styles for title, musical metadata, refrain, verses, and credits.

annotations.label: Song title
annotations.suggestion: Keep the 1.25× content heading and source-defined song semantics.

annotations.label: Musical metadata
annotations.suggestion: Keep the 0.875× content metadata role.

annotations.label: Refrain
annotations.suggestion: Keep italic refrains: the style conveys song structure.

annotations.label: Stanza number
annotations.suggestion: Keep the content-specific number role if it remains readable; do not spread light weight into UI controls.

annotations.label: Lyric body
annotations.suggestion: Keep the user-selected reading font and zoom.

annotations.label: Copyright
annotations.suggestion: Preserve credits, with enough contrast and wrapping; avoid reducing them below the current relative size.

title: Song keypad
summary: The song keypad has the same 28sp size as Bible navigation but a different inherited weight.

annotations.label: Songbook field
annotations.suggestion: Use the shared field role.

annotations.label: Entered code
annotations.suggestion: Use a shared numeric-input role, or intentionally share the Bible value role.

annotations.label: Keypad digit
annotations.suggestion: Specify the same weight as Bible KeypadDigit instead of inheriting TextButton labelLarge.

title: Song media sheet
summary: This sheet uses 22sp regular headings while audio selection uses 16sp medium.

annotations.label: Sheet heading
annotations.suggestion: Choose one sheet-heading role and use it in audio, highlighting, and feedback too.

annotations.label: Audio section
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared section-label role.

annotations.label: Playback time
annotations.suggestion: Use this readable 12sp timing role across Bible and song audio.

annotations.label: Video title
annotations.suggestion: Keep a compact list-title role and two-line wrapping.

annotations.label: Channel / statistics
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared caption role with sufficient contrast.

title: Song search
summary: A coherent 16sp / 12sp result hierarchy contrasts with Bible search references at 1.2× reading size.

annotations.label: Search field
annotations.suggestion: Use the same search-input role in Bible search.

annotations.label: Filter chips
annotations.suggestion: Reuse the filter role across both search surfaces.

annotations.label: Result title
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared result-primary style; use weight for a selected item rather than adding another size.

annotations.label: Book metadata
annotations.suggestion: Keep metadata subordinate; consider the regular caption role if medium is unnecessary.

title: Reading-plan download catalog
summary: Web content has a third tab treatment and exposes long technical IDs at primary-text size.

annotations.label: Plan title
annotations.suggestion: Keep primary size but move plan IDs to secondary text or a details view. The WebView default base is 16 CSS px.

annotations.label: Plan description / counts
annotations.suggestion: Set an explicit shared 14px supporting role instead of the browser small-size default.

annotations.label: Web tabs
annotations.suggestion: Align with the 14px songbook tabs and native 14sp medium tabs.

title: Active reading plan
summary: Several inherited XML text appearances produce 12sp, 14sp, 16sp, and 18sp roles on one screen.

annotations.label: Plan selector
annotations.suggestion: Use a shared toolbar selector role; align with the reader reference where appropriate.

annotations.label: Day heading
annotations.suggestion: Use the shared section-label role and sentence case where possible.

annotations.label: Reading reference
annotations.suggestion: Consider the shared 16sp primary list role, retaining a generous touch target.

annotations.label: Progress label
annotations.suggestion: Use a 14sp section label for a heading; reserve captions for secondary metadata.

annotations.label: Progress statistics
annotations.suggestion: Use 16sp body or a named numeric value role instead of inherited textAppearanceMedium.

annotations.label: Detail action
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared action style and align casing with Compose buttons.

title: Verse selection
summary: The smaller selection title is deliberate because it shares space with several actions.

annotations.label: Selection title
annotations.suggestion: Keep a compact navigation-title role; do not force a large screen title into the action mode.

annotations.label: Selection summary
annotations.suggestion: Consider 14sp supporting text to keep the reference primary.

annotations.label: Selected verse
annotations.suggestion: Keep the same content typography through selection; change only the necessary colors.

title: Highlight sheet
summary: This heading is 18sp bold, a third bottom-sheet heading treatment.

annotations.label: Reference heading
annotations.suggestion: Use the common sheet heading, or explicitly define a compact reference-heading exception.

annotations.label: Verse preview
annotations.suggestion: Use a named preview role; consider whether the chosen reader font should be preserved.

annotations.label: Dialog actions
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared action role across sheets and dialogs.

title: Color grid
summary: This page has a restrained 16sp value and 14sp tab/action hierarchy.

annotations.label: Hex value
annotations.suggestion: Keep the shared value role; optionally use tabular/monospace digits only for numeric alignment.

annotations.label: Picker tabs
annotations.suggestion: Keep shared tabs and ensure labels fit when scaled.

annotations.label: Dialog actions
annotations.suggestion: Keep the common action role.

title: Color sliders
summary: One control introduces 11sp semibold and 13sp regular, plus the normal 14sp values.

annotations.label: Channel label
annotations.suggestion: Replace 11sp semibold uppercase with a shared 12sp caption or 14sp section label.

annotations.label: Channel value
annotations.suggestion: Keep a common value style; use tabular digits for stable widths.

annotations.label: Hex field label
annotations.suggestion: Use the common 14sp supporting/field label instead of another 13sp exception.

annotations.label: Hex input
annotations.suggestion: Keep a named compact numeric input role; verify it still fits at 200%.

title: Reader at 200% system text
summary: The navigation reference is truncated enough to hide the chapter, while the content keeps its in-app size.

annotations.label: Reference: chapter lost
annotations.suggestion: Preserve chapter digits with a measured abbreviation/layout fallback. This capture uses fontScale 2.0; sp scaling is nonlinear on Android 14+. Frame clipping is a layout issue.

annotations.label: Version chip
annotations.suggestion: Use available width adaptively so the version chip does not force the chapter off screen.

annotations.label: Body remains 18dp
annotations.suggestion: Keep the independent reading controls if this policy is intentional; explain that policy in the UI and test all reading surfaces consistently.

title: Go To dialer at 200%
summary: Telusuri and Ketik wrap and are cut by a fixed-height toolbar/tab container.

annotations.label: Clipped tab labels
annotations.suggestion: Use scrollable single-line tabs or allow a taller tab row; avoid scaling text down to conceal the problem.

annotations.label: Dialer values
annotations.suggestion: Keep large values; make the surrounding row flexible and validate longer localized labels.

annotations.label: Keypad digit
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared keypad token and sufficient cell height at large text.

title: Go To grid at 200%
summary: The six fixed columns clip book abbreviations, including 1Sam / 2Sam and other longer labels.

annotations.label: Clipped abbreviation
annotations.suggestion: Use adaptive columns with a minimum measured width. Preserve complete book abbreviations at the user-selected text scale.

annotations.label: Clipped tabs
annotations.suggestion: Fix the tab layout together with the grid; changing font tokens alone will not solve this.

title: Bookmark categories
summary: Category labels are 18sp regular, while Settings and drawer categories use 16sp regular.

annotations.label: Screen title
annotations.suggestion: Use the common screen-title role.

annotations.label: Category label
annotations.suggestion: Use the shared 16sp list-primary role used by Settings and the drawer.

annotations.label: Sync action
annotations.suggestion: Keep the common action role and align casing with the sign-in actions.

title: Empty bookmark list
summary: The empty state already uses readable 16sp text; the long toolbar title ellipsizes at baseline.

annotations.label: Truncated screen title
annotations.suggestion: Use a concise localized screen title, leaving the full category name in content if needed.

annotations.label: Empty state
annotations.suggestion: Keep 16sp regular; share the same empty-state role with other lists.

title: Bible audio bar
summary: The bar uses 11sp medium time labels, smaller than the 12sp song media timing role.

annotations.label: Speed action
annotations.suggestion: Keep the shared action role.

annotations.label: Time label
annotations.suggestion: Use a shared 12sp timing role with song media and tabular digits. Debug version DDD is shown only to reach the audio controls.

title: Bible audio selection
summary: The sheet title is the same nominal size as its list items and relies on medium weight for hierarchy.

annotations.label: Sheet title
annotations.suggestion: Use the same sheet-title role as media/highlighting, with enough separation from the rows.

annotations.label: Recording choice
annotations.suggestion: Keep a shared list-primary role.

title: Audio speed sheet
summary: A 16sp medium sheet heading differs from the 18sp bold and 22sp regular headings elsewhere.

annotations.label: Sheet title
annotations.suggestion: Use a shared sheet-title role across audio speed, recording choice, media, and feedback.

annotations.label: Speed choices
annotations.suggestion: Keep the common chip/action-label role and tabular digits for stable values.
